snippet.title: Chowdown Kitty | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Chowdown Kitty now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2944590/Chowdown_Kitty/ 

Chowdown Kitty is a cozy Match 3 game where you line up tiles of treats to feed and unlock an adorable CAT-alogue of kitty’s and dress them up in cute accessories and toys!
